title: HABILIS Brain 0: Geometry-Change Supervision for Vision-Language-Action and Residual Flow Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2609.25558v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action policies benefit from geometric supervision, but current-frame geometry alone does not explicitly describe the changes associated with manipulation. This design is motivated by the goal of learning an embodiment-agnostic visual interface that can be pretrained across robot and egocentric video before robot-specific action alignment. We introduce Geometry-Change VLA (GC-VLA), which learns to predict multiview future-current geometry-change tokens from current observations. Offline frame pairs define a nominal 0.5-second prediction horizon; future observations are used only to construct training targets. Stage 1 trains a geometry-change vision-language model (GC-VLM). Stage 2 introduces a continuous ActionExpert and aligns it with robot actions while stopping action-flow gradients at the VLM interface. Stage 3 enables these gradients to update the trainable VLM components jointly with the ActionExpert. Stage 4 free

translated_title: HABILIS Brain 0：面向视觉-语言-动作与残差流恢复的几何变化监督
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略受益于几何监督，但仅依靠当前帧的几何信息并不能显式描述与操作相关的变化。这一设计的动机是学习一个与具身形态无关的视觉接口，使其能够在机器人特定的动作对齐之前，跨机器人和第一人称视频进行预训练。我们提出了几何变化VLA（GC-VLA），它学习从当前观测中预测多视角的未来-当前几何变化token。离线帧对定义了名义上0.5秒的预测时域；未来观测仅用于构建训练目标。阶段1训练一个几何变化视觉-语言模型（GC-VLM）。阶段2引入一个连续的ActionExpert，并将其与机器人动作对齐，同时在VLM接口处阻断动作流梯度。阶段3使这些梯度能够与ActionExpert共同更新可训练的VLM组件。阶段4（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出GC-VLA框架，通过学习从当前观测预测多视角未来-当前几何变化token，并采用四阶段渐进式训练将几何变化监督与连续ActionExpert结合，实现了与具身形态无关、可在机器人和第一人称视频上预训练的视觉接口。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GC-VLA, a framework that learns to predict multiview future-current geometry-change tokens from current observations and uses a four-stage progressive training pipeline with a continuous ActionExpert to build an embodiment-agnostic visual interface pretrainable across robot and egocentric video.
